title: A Small Ask From The Team
message:
## Hey editors

I'll be honest with you — you already love Flex GUI Pro. That part is done. What we're missing is every editor still working the slow way because they've never heard of it.

### So here's the ask: post about Flex in a Reel or a Story

And please don't skip this because your account is small. 10 followers is fine. 10 followers who edit is worth more than 10,000 who don't.

- Show the one feature that saves you the most time
- Five seconds is enough — don't overthink it
- Tag us and we'll reshare you

### Tag this profile

https://www.instagram.com/ig_sanu98/

I just handle announcements around here. But I've heard the owner say what he's actually chasing — Flex sitting in every editor's workspace, everywhere. That only happens if the people already using it talk about it.

One post. That's all. Thank you. — Team Flex
